about:
Cleartec Packaging operates from Park Hills, Missouri, as a division of MOCAP. The company maintains additional facilities across North America and Europe, including locations in Canada, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Poland. No founding year or original founders are disclosed in public materials.

The business manufactures plastic tubes, containers, caps, and plugs for both consumer and industrial packaging markets. Its product line includes closures, candy containers, craft containers, donation canisters, and golf ball containers. An online item customizer and a stocked-items catalog suggest both made-to-order and off-the-shelf fulfillment, though specific production processes, facility size, and annual volumes are not published.

Customers span consumer-goods brands needing candy or craft packaging, industrial firms requiring protective closures, and organizations ordering donation canisters or promotional golf-ball containers. The company's international sales offices indicate it serves multinational accounts as well as regional distributors.

Cleartec emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, awarded by ABS Quality Evaluations, as evidence of a formal quality management system. The division structure under MOCAP provides access to a broader supply-chain network, though the company does not publicly articulate a unique founding mission or proprietary technology.
